made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/cielo-sheet-make.js, from cielo-set.html (window.CIELO.E) and the design of El cielo (the orchestrator's p7-spec, section cielo). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 152. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), z up; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 152 + 13 v - 22.5 z. The picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62; its last row (215) is at v 4.9
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the sand; z 0.25: the deck's floor; z 0.69: the rocking chair's seat; z 0.97: the table's top; z .9 over the telescope's foot: the frog on it) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): its bottom middle is on the spot (bottom), except the cord (a box from z 1.2 to z BEAM - .2 round the set's cord) and the round picture (a box on the screen). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 41 rows drawn standing for a child (Luis and Carmen); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her head's middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; she faces right and her knees run to column 17 + 25; her head is the top 14 rows (rows -36 to -23 from the lap); a small thing: see spot. Nobody is drawn turned (the makers draw them from the front)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.cord: cuerda: a box 10 px wide from z 1.2 to z BEAM - .2 = 2.4 at the set's cord (u -1.315, v 0.42: the middle of the wall the set draws, -1.33 to -1.3; the right post is at u -1.28): the box [81,103,10,28]
rules.sky: the sky is screen space (the set's skyOf): E.SKY gives the sun [x, y, r], the small cloud [x, y], the moon [x, y, r], the big star [x, y] and the long cloud [x, y] in picture pixels; they do not move with the state (the sun and the small cloud are drawn by cielo azul, the moon, the star and the long cloud by cielo noche)

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel (or frond) that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the set's depth after frame(0), with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the deck's posts, the beam and the table hide whoever is behind them; the palm's fronds hide whoever is under them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where Z[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias. Z is window.DEPTH.live() of the set page after frame(0) (the baked depth, window.DEPTH.z, with the swaying fronds drawn at t 0); the baked depth alone does not see the fronds. The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.fronds: the palm's fronds sway: frame(t) draws them every tick (8 steps a second). The sheet and its checks take the depth and the pixels after frame(0); a frond that covers a spot at frame 0 counts as covering it. A frond at another moment of the sway can cover a little more or a little less
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on the chair, stands on the deck or sits on the telescope (z above 0) casts none: none of those is ground (a shadow cast at the sand under them would show in front of them)
